request.style: English, weathered male solo voice with sparse backing choir, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, light percussion, somber and majestic mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord
A righteous man, blameless among the crowd
He walked with God in the dark and the storm
Shem and Ham and Japheth by his side stood

[Pre-Chorus]
The earth was filled with violence and sin
God said the end of all flesh had come in
Make yourself an ark of cypress wood
Coat it with pitch, keep the family good

[Chorus]
Two of every living creature, male and female
Birds of every kind, kept alive and stable
Rain on the earth for forty days and nights
Wiping out every living being from the sights

[Verse]
Noah was six hundred years old that day
Went into the ark to keep the family safe
The springs of the deep burst open wide
The floodgates of heaven opened their eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
The waters rose and lifted the ark high
Drifting on the surface, under the sky
Fifteen cubits above the mountains' peak
Only Noah was left, for the world to seek

[Chorus]
Two of every living creature, male and female
Birds of every kind, kept alive and stable
Rain on the earth for forty days and nights
Wiping out every living being from the sights

[Verse]
God remembered Noah and sent a wind
The waters began to subside, leaving behind
On the seventeenth day of the seventh month
The ark came to rest, calm and strong

[Pre-Chorus]
He opened the window and sent out a raven
Flying back and forth, watching the haven
Then he sent a dove to see if the ground was dry
Waiting in the ark, watching the sky

[Chorus]
Two of every living creature, male and female
Birds of every kind, kept alive and stable
Rain on the earth for forty days and nights
Wiping out every living being from the sights

[Bridge]
Toward evening the dove came back to him
With a freshly plucked olive leaf in its rim
He knew the waters had gone down from the earth
Noah’s faith was the hidden birth

[Outro]
He waited seven more days and sent the dove again
But this time it did not return
The ground was dry, the covenant was made
In the rainbow, God’s promise is played
